question: Should this repository enable the public comment-triggered caller only after the central workflow runs in the documented credential-free allowlisted boundary and passes adversarial-canary proof?
rationale: The required runner-isolation boundary and its acceptable evidence are security and release-gate choices that cannot be resolved by this repository-local caller alone.

options.title: Require isolation proof before enabling
options.body: Keep the caller unmerged until the central execution boundary is credential-free, allowlisted, adversarially tested, and explicitly approved.

options.title: Decline this enrollment
options.body: Do not enable repository-local command triggering if the required isolated execution environment is not available.

recommendation.title: Require isolation proof before enabling
recommendation.body: Keep the caller unmerged until the central execution boundary is credential-free, allowlisted, adversarially tested, and explicitly approved.
